Class menuController

java.lang.Object
ass2.ass2_jfx.controller.menuController
public class menuController extends Object
Controller for the Main Menu screen. Responsibilities: - Initializing localized button text - Handling navigation to Play mode - Handling navigation to Design mode
Version:
Java 21
Author:
Shane O'Connell, Joshua MacPherson
